_readme: Maps each 'Vídeos Tratados' month subfolder name to its public Google Drive folder ID, so resolve_drive_url.py can find a specific video's public URL (the parent 'Vídeos Tratados' folder is shared publicly, but its embed view only lists one level deep, so each month subfolder needs its own ID). 'Stories/Reels' and 'Usados' intentionally excluded from reel selection (see lib_media.py SKIP_DIR_NAMES_VIDEO) but kept here for reference.
